summary: Iteration 3 validated the LendSprint AI CREDIT BRAIN Phase 1 feature set end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass (added 11 new tests covering credit-policy CRUD/versioning, simulate, credit-brain endpoint (persisted + on-the-fly), policy-evaluation 404/200, and the full decision engine for Arvind (approve/B/roi 20/tenure 48/memo 744 words/policy PASS 8 rules), Sri Lakshmi (review/C), and BluePeak (400 without docs -> reject with critical POL-* rules triggered and 4 phase-1 audit events). Fixed 3 stale prior-iter assertions (model_version -> credit-brain-v1.0, BluePeak now rejects, tenure_months field name, decision->rejected status). Frontend E2E on preview URL: Credit Policy page renders header (v1.4 active after Save & Activate), editable thresholds, ROI/tenure slabs, Policy Simulator (shows current vs proposed mix), and Version History (v1.4->v1.0). Application Detail tabs Credit Brain (financial grid + cash flow bars with real height style e.g. 82%/77%), Policy (overall PASS badge, 8 expandable rules), Decision (Recommended Loan Structure, eligibility waterfall with 6 lines, REJECT/APPROVE badges, Override) all functional. Credit Memo tab 744-word memo with copy + download-memo-btn present. Dashboard shows all 8 required columns (Application, Borrower, Product, Requested, Recommended, Status, Decision, EMI). BluePeak decision confirmed REJECT in UI with terms 22% / 36mo / EMI 53,467 and policy fails.

ui_bugs.issue: For BluePeak after reject the app status pill still shows 'Pending' next to the REJECT decision badge — application.status may not update to 'rejected' consistently (backend does update in some paths). Cosmetic but confusing.
ui_bugs.selector: status badge next to reference number

issues: When max_foir=0.4 is entered alone (matching PRD wording), no borrower flips because Arvind's post-loan FOIR is 25.8% (still under 0.4). Simulator correctly shows 'No decision changes'. Reviewer copy in review request implied a flip; combining with min_cibil=750 (as backend test does) produces flips. Consider default the simulator preset or update copy so QA gets a change row on the exact 0.4 entry.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Ensure application.status transitions to 'rejected'/'approved'/'review' after decision so the top pill in ApplicationDetail doesn't remain 'Pending' post-decision (BluePeak observed).
OPTIONAL: Simulator UX — pre-fill both max_foir 0.4 and min_cibil 750 (or lower approve_pd_max) so a fresh QA of the PRD wording yields at least one change row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1269 lines — split into modules (auth, applications, credit_brain, credit_policy, memo) for maintainability.

PUT /api/credit-policy always bumps version + archives previous, even for no-op saves. Consider skipping bump if computed policy is identical to the active one to avoid version noise (test run went v1.0 -> v1.4 quickly).

credit-policy/simulate re-runs compute_full_decision for every application on every call; fine for demo scale (<100 apps) but note O(N) cost — pre-filter to decided/pending relevant apps as data grows.
credit_brain endpoint returns document-heavy 'application' plus brain — acceptable for demo but consider trimming to keep responses <32KB.
PolicyTab renders every rule expandable inline (good), but bulk expand/collapse control would help review of 8+ rules.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/demo/seed is idempotent. During tests uploaded a small PDF to BluePeak, and PUT-updated the credit policy (v1.0 -> v1.4 across runs). Also created 3 TEST_ borrower apps via pytest (safe prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite now covers: credit-policy GET/PUT/versions/simulate, credit-brain endpoint (both persisted and computed branches), policy-evaluation 404/200, and full decision engine for Arvind/Sri Lakshmi/BluePeak. The credit_policy 'active' rules may drift as PUT tests keep bumping the version; tests are resilient to that (accept 0.6 or 0.58). BluePeak decision shows in UI as REJECT with 22%/36mo but application.status pill in header stays 'Pending' (minor UI drift). AI-memo toggle default OFF used throughout for reliability.
